mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO access_log (user_id, username, method, uri, query_string, status_code, response_time_ms, ip_address, user_agent, created_time) VALUES
(#{item.userId}, #{item.username}, #{item.method}, #{item.uri}, #{item.queryString}, #{item.statusCode}, #{item.responseTimeMs}, #{item.ipAddress}, #{item.userAgent}, #{item.createdTime})
mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') AS stat_hour, COUNT(*) AS total_requests, COUNT(DISTINCT username) AS unique_users, CAST(AVG(response_time_ms) AS UNSIGNED) AS avg_response_time_ms, MAX(response_time_ms) AS max_response_time_ms, SUM(CASE WHEN status_code >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS error_count FROM access_log WHERE created_time >= #{startTime} AND created_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') ORDER BY stat_hour
